prompts.spring: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game SPRITE ATLAS with genuinely transparent alpha, exactly FIVE EQUAL COLUMNS and SIX EQUAL ROWS (30 isolated sprites). Input image is a design/fit reference ONLY: compact hats, neckwear, belt pouches for cute chibi female and male farmers. No mannequin, no characters, no head, no body, no text, no labels, no grid, no background shadows. spring gender-specific designs: female: natural straw cloche hat with bright pink ribbon and white daisies; coral-pink tied neckerchief; compact lavender waist pouch with mint flap and tiny daisy. male: straw farmer hat with cobalt blue ribbon and yellow flower; vivid turquoise tied bandana; compact orange waist pouch with cobalt flap. Exact row order: 1 FEMALE HAT, 2 FEMALE NECKWEAR, 3 FEMALE WAIST POUCH BODY, 4 MALE HAT, 5 MALE NECKWEAR, 6 MALE WAIST POUCH BODY. Exact column order in every row: FRONT, front three-quarter facing RIGHT, pure RIGHT PROFILE, rear three-quarter facing RIGHT, pure BACK. Each row is the same object smoothly rotated, same design/material/colors. Eye-level orthographic camera. Hats have closed crowns and snug head openings, NOT a large dark visible underside. Bandanas/scarves are snug wrapped collars with tails only at front; rear view shows back triangle for bandana or snug wrapped collar for scarf. Waist pouches are tiny rectangular leather/tool pouches as in reference, belt loops on back, NO handles and NO shoulder straps and NO belt ring (game draws the fitted waist belt). Clean high-detail soft 3D rendered toy style; joyful saturated harmonious colors. Uniform cell layout and generous 15% transparent margins per cell; never cross cell boundaries. Portrait 5:6 canvas. Do not reproduce the reference sheet's writing or dolls.
